entities.name: RlmN
observations: The 438-aa query sequence is strongly homologous to curated RlmN proteins: 61.7–65.4% identity, 83.3–87.2% query coverage, and E-values of 3.24e-169 to 6.55e-159.
RlmN is a dual-specificity radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenine N2 in 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37.
The enzyme binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).
Curated homologs assign EC 2.1.1.192 and cytoplasmic localization.

entities.name: RlmN RNA adenine N2 methylation
observations: For 23S rRNA A2503: adenosine(2503) + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-ferredoxin + 2 SAM → 2-methyladenosine(2503) + 5'-deoxyadenosine + methionine + 2 oxidized ferredoxin + SAH.
For tRNA A37, the analogous reaction yields N2-methyladenosine at position 37.
The reaction is radical-SAM dependent and is represented by Rhea 42916 and Rhea 43332 in curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: RlmN [4Fe-4S] cluster
observations: RlmN binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster through three cysteine ligands; SAM participates as the fourth exchangeable ligand in the radical-SAM active site.
